$comment: Package-owned manifest of trusted built-in Pet Skill bundles. Pet installs ONLY the bundles declared here and never scans this directory for undeclared content. Each `directory` is resolved relative to this file and copied into an immutable content-addressed revision in the Pet state store; Pet never executes from node_modules. create-mr and send-cr are authored against the installed `bytedcli codebase mr create` and `lark-cli im +messages-send` contracts; when those CLIs are absent the capability reports itself unavailable instead of breaking Pet.
